hero.title: The pathologist's toolkit, sharpened
hero.subtitle: Scoring, staging and differential support in one place — no spreadsheets, no guesswork.
hero.note: Free while in beta. No card required.

proposition.title: Built around the sign-out, not around the demo
proposition.subtitle: Every tool exists because it removes a step you already do by hand.

scores.title: Scores you can defend
scores.body: Grading and index calculators that show the inputs behind the number, so the result is reproducible on review.

staging.title: Staging without the PDF hunt
staging.body: Interactive TNM assignment that keeps the criteria next to the choice instead of in a separate document.

reporting.title: Report-ready output
reporting.body: Results formatted to drop straight into a report — consistent wording, consistent units, no retyping.

imaging.title: Image-assisted counting
imaging.body: Hotspot and cellularity estimation from a photomicrograph, with the count always open to correction.

toolsSection.title: The tools
toolsSection.subtitle: Shipping one at a time. Everything below is in the queue.
toolsSection.footnote: Tools are for professional use by qualified pathologists. Output supports — it never replaces — your judgement.

cta.title: Set up an account now, use the tools as they land
cta.subtitle: Creating an account takes a minute and keeps your language and preferences in sync across devices.

footer.placeholderNote: Institutional pages are placeholders while the product is in beta.

setup.body: Copy .env.example to .env and fill in the Firebase web app credentials, then restart the dev server. Authentication and profiles stay disabled until then.
